definition.text: Magician or sorcerer, the Arabic name of the Jew Bar-jesus, who withstood Paul and Barnabas in Cyprus. He was miraculously struck with blindness (Acts 13:11).

works.title: Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Series 1, Volume 1: Augustine — Confessions and Letters
